title: Camper Rental Office Responsible in Tromsø
description:
Office Responsible -- Join Our International Team in Norway

We are currently seeking a dedicated and motivated Office Responsible to join our dynamic team. This is a key role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys balancing structure, communication, and customer service. If you are detail-oriented, solution-driven, and looking to contribute to a growing company in the travel and outdoor industry, we would be pleased to hear from you.

About the Role

As the Office Responsible, you will be the first point of contact for many of our customers and a central figure in our day-to-day operations. You will handle booking and pre-booking coordination, assist with post-rental customer service, and manage internal support functions such as invoicing and payment allocations.

You will also provide critical backup to our rental agent team when needed, offering variety and ensuring smooth operations across departments. This position requires strong communication skills, a proactive mindset, and the ability to stay focused when working with complex information.

We are looking for a candidate who brings prior experience in coordination work or a similar office-based role, and is comfortable taking ownership of tasks in a structured and organized manner.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide customer support before, during, and after the booking process through email, phone, and online chat

  • Manage booking entries and updates within our booking system

  • Handle deposit processing, damage claims, and customer inquiries post-rental

  • Allocate ferry tickets, tolls, and parking fees to the correct bookings

  • Process invoices, purchase orders, and general company paperwork

  • Support internal accounting by preparing accurate Excel spreadsheets

  • Assist the rental team with operational tasks during busy periods

  • Suggest and support improvements to office workflows and processes


Who We Are Looking For

  • Proven experience in coordination, administration, or a similar office-based role

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English (Norwegian is not required)

  • Excellent focus and attention to detail, especially when working with data and allocations

  • Solid working knowledge of Excel and basic accounting practices

  • A problem-solver with a service-oriented mindset

  • Positive, proactive, and eager to take initiative

  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team

  • Open to supporting and collaborating with a diverse, international group


Our Work Environment

You will be joining a young and international team based in Norway, made up of outdoor-minded individuals from around the world. Our company language is English, and our work culture values openness, collaboration, and initiative. While the position is office-based, you will be part of a business that supports adventurous travel experiences across the country.

Why Join Us

This is an excellent opportunity to take on a varied and responsible role within a growing company. You will work closely with management and other departments, contribute directly to customer satisfaction and operational efficiency, and be encouraged to bring your ideas to the table.

We offer a supportive and flexible work environment, where professional development is valued, and where your role can evolve as the company grows.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Arctic Campers is Norway's largest camper van rental company, offering 200 camper vans across two locations: Oslo and Tromsø. With over 10 years of experience, we specialize in helping tourists explore and enjoy the stunning Norwegian nature. Our goal is to provide unforgettable adventures, giving you the freedom to discover Norway at your own pace.

title: Meningsfylt deltidsjobb som assistent i Oslo
description:
Er du på utkikk etter en variert og meningsfylt deltidsjobb?

Jeg er en personi 30-årene som jobber som politisk rådgiver og er folkevalgt. Nå søker jeg flere assistenter til både BPA og funksjonsassistanse. Jeg ser først og fremst etter tilkallingsassistenter, men for den rette personen kan det bli aktuelt med en fast deltidsstilling etter hvert.

Arbeidsstedet vil hovedsakelig være på hjemmekontoret mitt på Stovner, men du vil også bistå meg på eksterne møter, konferanser, politiske arrangementer og reiser.

Om jobben

Jeg jobber som politisk rådgiver med menneskerettigheter, likestilling og funksjonshemmedes rettigheter -- saker jeg virkelig brenner for. Som assistent vil du være en viktig del av arbeidshverdagen min og bidra til at jeg kan delta aktivt både i jobb, politikk og samfunnsliv.

Arbeidsoppgavene er varierte og vil endre seg fra dag til dag. En stor del av jobben består av praktisk assistanse i forbindelse med arbeid, blant annet bistand på hjemmekontoret, skrive- og leseassistanse, notater under møter, organisering og enkle administrative oppgaver. Du vil også være med på møter, konferanser, politiske arrangementer og reiser ved behov.

I tillegg vil du bistå med praktiske oppgaver i hverdagen, som matlaging, handling, lett husarbeid og annen tilrettelegging som gjør at jeg kan bruke tiden og energien min på jobb, politiske verv og et aktivt liv. Noen oppgaver innebærer også personlig assistanse, og du vil få grundig opplæring i alt du trenger å kunne.

Arbeidstiden vil være fordelt på dagtid (mandag, torsdag og fredag) og enkelte kvelder. Arbeidshverdagen min varierer, og det kan oppstå oppdrag på kort varsel. Derfor er fleksibilitet en stor fordel, særlig for deg som søker tilkallingsstilling.

Hvem ser jeg etter?

For å trives i stillingen tror jeg at du:

  • er punktlig og pålitelig

  • tar initiativ og ser hva som må gjøres

  • har god hukommelse

  • kan jobbe både selvstendig og i samarbeid med meg

  • behersker norsk og engelsk, både muntlig og skriftlig

  • er komfortabel med PC eller Mac og har gode digitale ferdigheter

  • gjerne har erfaring med akademisk skriving, referansehåndtering (APA) eller programmer som EndNote (en fordel, men ikke et krav)

  • har førerkort (ikke et krav)

  • er over 18 år

  • liker katter

Erfaring

Du trenger ikke tidligere erfaring som assistent. Det viktigste er at du er lærevillig, ansvarsbevisst og har lyst til å bidra. Du vil få god opplæring og den støtten du trenger for å føle deg trygg i rollen.

Mangfold er en styrke

Jeg ønsker søkere med ulik bakgrunn og oppfordrer spesielt personer med minoritetsbakgrunn og LHBTQIA+-personer til å søke. Stillingen passer også godt for studenter, freelansere eller andre som ønsker en fleksibel deltidsjobb med stor variasjon.

Hvordan søke?

Send en personlig søknad, CV og referanser på e-post eller via Ulobas jobbportal. Fortell litt om deg selv, hvorfor du tror vi vil fungere godt sammen.

Har du spørsmål, er du hjertelig velkommen til å ta kontakt. Aktuelle kandidater kontaktes fortløpende.

Jeg gleder meg til å høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsleder

Jeg er i 30-årene og bor på Stovner i Oslo sammen med katten min Stella ("Bolla"). Til daglig jobber jeg som politisk rådgiver og er folkevalgt. Jeg brenner for menneskerettigheter, likestilling og et samfunn der alle kan delta på egne premisser. Jeg liker samfunnsdebatt, litteratur og en variert hverdag med alt fra hjemmekontor, møter, til arrangementer, hvile og reiser.

Jeg bruker BPA fordi det gir meg friheten til å leve det livet jeg ønsker. Jeg ser etter assistenter som er trygge, løsningsorienterte og trives med varierte dager. Et godt samarbeid bygger på tillit, respekt, åpen kommunikasjon og gjerne litt humor underveis -- og det er en fordel om du også setter pris på selskapet til katten min.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Bistå i fritidsaktivitet, trening og hobbyer

  • Matlaging og/eller tilrettelegging av måltid

  • Assistere med aktiviteter og daglige gjøremål

  • Kontorarbeid

  • Assistere med personlig hygiene

  • Husarbeid

  • Assistere på kortere og lengre reiser

Hva forventer jeg av deg?

  • God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne

  • Du er tålmodig og løsningsorientert

  • Du må være punktlig og pålitelig

  • Du må være fleksibel og serviceinnstilt

  • Må beherske data

  • Du er positiv og jobber selvstendig

  • Må kunne jobbe ferier og helligdager

  • Du må kunne omgås husdyr

  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt

Arbeidstid

  • Helg

  • Dag

  • Kveld

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Uloba - en ideell organisasjon og en del av Independent Living-bevegelsen. 1500 medlemmer -- alle med egenerfaring som funksjonshemmet. Vi arbeider for full likestilling, samfunnsdeltakelse og livsutfoldelse for funksjonshemmede. Målet er likeverdige og verdiskapende samfunnsborgere.

Vår visjon; en verden der funksjonshemmede har frihet til livsutfoldelse og deltar på alle samfunnets arenaer. Gjennom vår politikk, vårt arbeid og vår visjon skal vi;

• Endre samfunnets oppfatning av funksjonshemmede, og samtidig endre funksjonshemmedes oppfatning av seg selv

• Arbeide aktivt for full likestilling, samfunnsdeltakelse og livsutfoldelse for funksjonshemmede

• Aktivt bekjempe diskriminering, umyndiggjøring, sykeliggjøring og institusjonalisering av funksjonshemmede.

Vi legger til rette for Borgerstyrt Personlig Assistanse (BPA) - et frigjøringsverktøy for funksjonshemmede med assistansebehov.

Våre verdier: Stolt, Sterk og Synlig!

title: Business Development Representative (m/w/d) – Deutschsprachig – Krakau, Polen (Key-Account-Manager/in)
description:
As a Business Development Representative with German-English working Hybrid in Krakow, Poland, you’ll be a part of bringing humanity to business. #experienceTTEC

Our employees have spoken. Our purpose, team, and company culture are amazing and our Great Place to Work® certification in Poland says it all!

Looking to build long term relationships as a trusted advisor? Do you have a passion to maximize sales opportunities over the long term? You'll deliver amazing customer service and uncover sales opportunities for our technology client's customers. With a consultative selling approach and focus on revenue targets, you'll cultivate existing customer relationships while establishing and maintaining long-term relationships. You'll work both independently and collaboratively with a cross-functional team to identify and solve business technology needs in a cloud-based environment.

You'll report to the Operations Sales Manager. You’ll contribute to the success of the customer experience as well as the overall success of the team.

- Reside in or able to relocate to the Krakow area

title: Front Office Supervisor  (Empfangschef/in (Hotel))
description:
Front Office Supervisor

Opis firmy

Tworzymy wyjątkowe miejsce dla naszych Gości dzięki wspólnej pasji do nowoczesnego designu i wysokiej jakości obsługi.

Już ponad 100 hoteli w 13 krajach imponują wyjątkowym designem, najwyższymi standardami obsługi i doskonałymi lokalizacjami w samym sercu miast.

Dołącz do naszego zespołu w Gdańsku!

Odkryj możliwości pracy w miejscu, gdzie liczy się pasja, zaangażowanie i chęć rozwoju!

Opis oferty pracy

Twoim priorytetem będzie troska o dobre samopoczucie Gości i Pracowników!

Twoje obowiązki będą obejmować również:

- Meldowanie Gości, sprawdzanie listy przyjazdów oraz innych raportów
- Zapewnienie profesjonalnej, najwyższej jakości obsługi
- Monitorowanie oraz reagowanie na opinie Gości

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Kwalifikacje

Czy posiadasz wyjątkową osobowość oraz doskonałe umiejętności z zakresu gościnności?

Jeśli tak, to idealnie będziesz pasować na to stanowisko! Nasze dodatkowe wymagania:

- Doświadczenie zawodowe w branży hotelarskiej
- Doskonałe wyczucie jakości i obsługi
- Otwartość, komunikatywność oraz bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego (w mowie i piśmie)
- Umiejętność pracy w zespole i gotowość do udzielania pomocy we wszystkich działach – wyniki osiąga się dzięki współpracy!
- Praca w godzinach porannych, popołudniowych i/lub nocnych

title: Senior Accountant Manager  (Leiter/in - Finanz- und Rechnungswesen)
description:
Senior Accountant Manager

Opis firmy

Ponad 100 hoteli w 13 krajach, które imponują wyjątkowym designem, najwyższymi standardami obsługi i doskonałymi lokalizacjami w samym sercu miast, a wszystko to w atrakcyjnej cenie. Jako założyciel i prekursor koncepcji budget design, z sukcesem rozwijamy się w metropoliach Europy i poza nią.

Opis oferty pracy

- Prowadzenie i nadzór nad księgowością operacyjną hoteli w Polsce zgodnie z obowiązującymi standardami oraz wytycznymi Centrali;
- Uzgadnianie rejestru VAT zakupu i sprzedaży;
- Raportowanie wyników finansowych dla hoteli w Gdańsku i Warszawie do Centrali, w tym analiza odchyleń oraz rekomendowanie działań korygujących.
- Ścisła współpraca z działem Controllingu, audytorami i pozostałymi działami hotelowymi w zakresie zagadnień finansowych, w tym obsługi procesów KSeF.
- Przygotowywanie przelewów do płatności, księgowanie wyciągów, rozliczanie kart kredytowych
- Przygotowywanie tygodniowych, miesięcznych i rocznych raportów finansowych zgodnie z wymaganiami działu kontroli finansowej.
- Czynny udział w procesach zamknięcia miesiąca, obejmujący uzgadnianie kont, kontrolę kosztów, inwentaryzację oraz weryfikację danych operacyjnych hoteli.
- Zapewnienie terminowego przygotowania dokumentacji do składania deklaracji podatkowych oraz zgodności z przepisami prawa podatkowego.
- Wsparcie w bieżących analizach finansowych oraz projektach związanych z optymalizacją kosztów i efektywnością operacyjną hoteli.
- Dbanie o prawidłowy obieg dokumentów w firmie oraz weryfikacja prawidłowości dokumentów księgowych

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Kwalifikacje

- Wyższe wykształcenie ekonomiczne;
- Min. 4 lata doświadczenia w dziale kontrolingu, mile widziane w branży hotelarskiej;
- Praktyczna, zaawansowana znajomość pakietu MS Office (w szczególności Excel);
- Znajomość języka angielskiego lub niemieckiego - warunek konieczny;
- Znajomość specyfiki finansów hotelowych (USALI) oraz wskaźników charakterystycznych dla branży hotelarskiej;

title: Senior Solution Architect IT/OT Security Platforms (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
description:
Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.
As a Solution Architect for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts, while our OT Patch Management enables centralized endpoint management, patching, hardening and compliance for enterprise and production-related devices.

What we offer you
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career.  From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

You'll make an impact by

- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security Platforms (SINEC Secure Connect and ManageEngine), ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements.- You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases.- You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints.- You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps.- You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens.- You define integration concepts between connectivity services, endpoint management platforms, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems.- You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape.- You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability.- You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services

This is how you'll win us over

- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification.- Experience and Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443.- You have proven experience with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures.- You bring solid knowledge of Endpoint, Asset and Service Management Architectures, including endpoint management, asset discovery, software deployment, patch management, CMDB, and IT service management platforms.- You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps.- You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design.
- Ways of Working: - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments.- You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).
- Languages: •    Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us.
As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/arbeiten-bei-siemens/inklusion.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About Us
To solve the biggest challenges of our time, we need bright minds with the ambition to make the impossible possible. Siemens is the place where you can thrive, challenge the status quo, make an impact, and grow alongside a team of innovators who share your passion for technology. Are you in?

title: Job i udlandet - Job i Portugal med firmabolig - Kunderådgiver for Audi - Opstart den 1. oktober - Book en samtale i dag!
description:
Dansktalende Kundeservicerådgiver for Audi - Opstart den 1. oktober - Vi tilbyder firmabolig.

Er du klar til at tage springet og blive en del af en global digital organisation, der leverer support i verdensklasse?

Vi søger tekniske supportere til en spændende rolle med Audi – en af Europas mest ikoniske bilproducenter. Stillingen er 100 % remote fra Portugal, og du bliver en nøglespiller i et internationalt team, der sikrer en ekstraordinær kunderejse for Audi’s brugere.

Hvad laver en Kundeservicerådgiver?

Som Kundeservicerådgiver er du kundens direkte kontaktpunkt og hjælper med alt fra bilteknologi til digitale funktioner og serviceydelser. Du skaber en professionel oplevelse med struktur, empati og høj kvalitet i centrum.

Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Besvarelse af henvendelser via telefon, e-mail og chat

  • Fejlsøgning af tekniske problemer og vejledning i bilsystemer

  • Registrering af kundeinteraktioner i CRM-systemet

  • Opdatering på Audi’s produkter og politikker

  • Aktiv deltagelse i teamets deling af best practices

Dine kvalifikationer:

Vi leder efter dig, hvis du:

  • Taler og skriver dansk + har et minimum B2-niveau i engelsk

  • Har erfaring med kundeservice – gerne fra bilbranchen

  • Har teknisk flair og interesse for digitale løsninger

  • Kan kommunikere tydeligt, løse problemer og skabe tillid

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav – vi opfordrer dig stadig til at søge!

Vi tilbyder:

  • Mulighed for firmabolig i Braga

  • Konkurrencedygtig grundløn plus bonusordning

  • Professionelle udviklingsmuligheder

  • Et samarbejdende og støttende arbejdsmiljø

  • Adgang til eksklusive rejsefordele og rabatter

  • Restaurantkort

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring

  • 14 lønudbetalinger om året

Fordele ved at arbejde i en international virksomhed i Portugal

  • Udvidelse af dine faglige kompetencer gennem globalt samarbejde

  • Forbedring af kommunikation og salgsteknikker i et internationalt miljø

  • Mulighed for karriereudvikling inden for kundeservice, salg og rejsebranchen

  • Adgang til et netværk af internationale kolleger og brancheeksperter

  • Erfaring med moderne digitale værktøjer til kundehåndtering

Dette er en unik mulighed for at kombinere en stærk erhvervserfaring med en fleksibel arbejdsmodel.

Fordele ved at arbejde fra Portugal

  • Mildt klima året rundt – Portugal har et behageligt middelhavsklima med varme somre og milde vintre, hvilket gør det til en attraktiv destination for dem, der ønsker at bo og arbejde i et solrigt land

  • Lavere leveomkostninger – Sammenlignet med mange andre europæiske lande er leveomkostningerne i Portugal relativt lave, hvilket giver mulighed for en høj livskvalitet til en rimelig pris.

  • Høj livskvalitet – Portugal er kendt for sin afslappede livsstil, gode mad og venlige lokalbefolkning, hvilket skaber et positivt og behageligt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Internationale karrieremuligheder – Arbejde i Portugal giver mulighed for at udvikle internationale færdigheder og samarbejde med kolleger fra forskellige nationaliteter, hvilket kan være en fordel for din fremtidige karriere.

  • God infrastruktur og moderne faciliteter – Portugal har en stærk digital infrastruktur, moderne kontorfaciliteter og gode transportmuligheder, hvilket sikrer en behagelig arbejdsdag.

  • Adgang til smukke strande og natur – Portugal tilbyder nem adgang til fantastiske strande, naturskønne områder og en rig kulturarv, som kan opleves både i fritiden og weekenderne.

  • Attraktiv skattepolitik for udlændinge – For internationale medarbejdere findes der skattefordele, der kan gøre det økonomisk fordelagtigt at arbejde i Portugal.

  • Voksende erhvervsliv og økonomi – Portugal har en blomstrende erhvervssektor, hvor flere internationale virksomheder etablerer sig, hvilket skaber gode jobmuligheder og karriereveje.

  • Stærkt netværk af expats og internationale virksomheder – Mange internationale virksomheder har kontorer i Portugal, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig i et globalt arbejdsmiljø.

Arbejdet i Portugal giver både professionel og personlig udvikling samt mulighed for at opleve en spændende livsstil med stor kulturel og økonomisk værdi.

title: Data Platform Engineer m/w/d (Data Scientist)
description:
At Damia Group Portugal (Permanent)Portugal
Expires at: 2027-05-12
Remote policy: Full remoteAbout the company: Damia Group is an international tech recruitment agency with 3 decades of experience. Our arrival in Portugal, 7 years later, was set on a mission to transform IT recruitment experiences and, through them, achieve better results. We believe in long-term relationships with a transparent and relaxed mindset. In a short period, we have reached the hearts of both scale-ups and larger organisations by delivering spot-on curated candidate shortlists, increased job offer acceptance rates and shorter time-to-fill.

Main requirements

Role OverviewThis is a senior, hands-on role for someone who views Data Infrastructure as a product.You will define how billions of records are structured, indexed, and exposed to the rest of the company. Ideal for someone who combines strong backend engineering skills with deep expertise in data platforms, data lakes, and large-scale data systems. Key Responsibilities

-
Database Reliability & Scaling:

- Own the health and performance of their core databases.
- Own and optimize their MongoDB clusters and OpenSearch indexes, which houses billions of documents. You will design sharding strategies and indexing patterns to ensure search performance.
- Design and implement a multi-tier storage strategy. You will determine which data remains "hot" in production databases for their Product team and which data is offloaded to "cold/analytical" storage for AI and R&D.
-
Data Access Layer:

- Build and maintain internal APIs that allow internal teams to build features without worrying about the underlying database complexities.
-
Schema Evolution & Migrations:

- Lead the strategy for updating data structures across billions of records. You will design "no-downtime" migration paths for their production MongoDB and OpenSearch environments.
-
Data Platform & Architecture

- Own and evolve their Core Data Architecture, ensuring it supports analytics, product features, AI workflows, and internal consumption.
- Evaluate the feasibility and ROI of introducing a Data Lakehouse architecture for long-term storage and AI training.
- Define standards for how data is ingested, stored, versioned, and exposed to downstream systems.
-
Data Quality & Documentation:

- Ensure data accuracy, freshness, and consistency through validation and testing.
- Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of pipelines, schemas, and data assets to enable internal adoption.
-
Collaboration:

- Act as a bridge between Core, Product, and R&D, ensuring research initiatives (e.g. data enrichment) are integrated into the Core platform.
- Translate business and product needs into scalable, maintainable data solutions.
- Comfortable working in async-first environments, keeping task statuses and documentation up to date for full team visibility.

What They're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in Backend, Data Engineering and/or Data Platform roles, specifically within high-concurrency/high-volume environments.
-
NoSQL & Search Expert. Professional experience tuning MongoDB and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch at massive scale (sharding, cluster topology, query optimization).

-
Strong Python Skills. Proficiency in writing production-grade, highly efficient Python. Experience with asynchronous programming (FastAPI, etc.) for building high-performance Internal APIs is essential.

-
System Design & Architecture. A strong grasp of distributed systems, including eventual consistency, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and caching strategies to protect production databases.

-
Strategic Storage Thinking. Familiarity with Data Lakehouse concepts (e.g., Parquet, Delta Lake, Iceberg). Proven experience building one.

- Excellent communication skills and attention to documentation.
- Self-managed and comfortable working cross-functionally.
- Fluent in English.
- Tax residency in Portugal.

title: TÉCNICO DE ENGENHARIA CIVIL
description:
Topógrafo - É o trabalhador que concebe, prepara, estuda, orienta e executa todos os trabalhos topográficos necessários à elaboração de planos, cartas, mapas, perfis longitudinais e transversais com apoio nas redes geodésicas existentes e ou nas redes de triangulação locais, por meio de figuras geométricas com compensação expedita (triangulação-quadriláteros) ou por interseção inversa (analítica ou gráfica), recorte ou por irradiação
direta ou inversa ou ainda por poligonação (fechada e compensada), como base de todos os demais trabalhos de levantamentos, quer clássicos quer fotogramétricos ou ainda hidrográficos, cadastrais ou de prospeção geológica. Determina rigorosamente a posição relativa de quaisquer pontos notáveis de determinada zona da  superfície terrestre, cujas coordenadas obtém por processos de triangulação, poligonação, trilateração ou outra.
Executa nivelamento de grande precisão. Implanta no terreno linhas gerais de apoio e todos os projetos de engenharia e arquitetura, bem como toda a piquetagem de pormenor. Fiscaliza, orienta e apoia a execução de obras públicas e de engenharia civil, na área da topografia aplicada, procedendo à verificação de implantações ou de montagem, com tolerâncias muito apertadas, a partir desta rede de apoio. Realiza todos os trabalhos
tendentes à avaliação de quantidades de obra efetuadas, a partir de elementos levantados por si ou a partir de desenhos de projeto e sempre também com base em elementos elaborados por si. Pode executar trabalhos cartográficos e de cadastro. Executa os trabalhos referidos e outros ligados às especialidades topográficas, com grande autonomia funcional.

title: OPERADOR DE CENTRAL TELEFÓNICA
description:
rocuramos um(a) Operador(a) de Call Center para integrar a equipa da SolarTécnica, com responsabilidade pela gestão de chamadas, qualificação de leads e agendamento de visitas comerciais/técnicas.

O perfil deverá apresentar elevada capacidade de comunicação verbal, voz e dicção claras, confiança e profissionalismo no contacto telefónico com clientes. Procuramos uma pessoa comunicativa, resiliente e orientada para objetivos, confortável com uma função em que a realização de chamadas constitui uma atividade central.

É fundamental demonstrar disciplina, organização e capacidade para seguir processos e scripts de contacto, adaptando a abordagem às necessidades e respostas de cada cliente. Deverá também ter capacidade para gerir objeções, manter uma atitude positiva perante a rejeição e assegurar um acompanhamento consistente dos contactos.

Entre as principais responsabilidades estarão: receber e efetuar chamadas; qualificar leads provenientes de diferentes canais; realizar contactos de seguimento e reativação de leads; agendar visitas técnicas e diagnósticos; cumprir as cadências de contacto definidas; e registar de forma rigorosa todas as interações, informações e próximos passos no CRM Bitrix24.

Requisitos: domínio da língua portuguesa, boa capacidade de comunicação, conhecimentos de informática na ótica do utilizador, facilidade na utilização de email, Excel básico e ferramentas CRM. Será valorizada experiência anterior em call center, atendimento telefónico, qualificação de leads ou agendamento comercial, embora não seja obrigatória.

Procuramos uma pessoa responsável, rigorosa, organizada, orientada para resultados, com capacidade de aprendizagem e espírito de equipa, que demonstre compromisso com os objetivos e procedimentos definidos pela empresa.

title: PINTOR DE CONSTRUÇÕES
description:
Pretende-se profissional com experiência prática na área da construção civil e reabilitação de edifícios, com especial aptidão para execução de trabalhos em altura através de técnicas de acesso e posicionamento por cordas.

É valorizada formação/certificação específica em trabalhos em altura, rapel profissional e/ou técnicas de acesso por cordas, bem como experiência na utilização de equipamentos de proteção individual, sistemas de ancoragem e demais equipamentos associados à execução segura de trabalhos verticais.

O profissional deverá possuir experiência ou conhecimentos práticos em intervenções de manutenção e reabilitação de fachadas, nomeadamente preparação de superfícies, pintura exterior, tratamento de fissuras, aplicação de argamassas e revestimentos, impermeabilizações e execução de reparações localizadas, recorrendo a técnicas de acesso por cordas sempre que as características da intervenção assim o exijam.

Pretende-se profissional com experiência prévia em trabalhos executados em altura, capacidade de adaptação a diferentes tipos de intervenção e edifícios, domínio e respeito pelos procedimentos de segurança, responsabilidade, assiduidade e capacidade de integração e trabalho em equipa.

O posto implica deslocações entre diferentes obras, predominantemente na região de Lisboa e concelhos limítrofes, devendo o profissional apresentar disponibilidade para o efeito.

description:

Procura-se candidato com interesse pela área da mecânica, aptidão para trabalhos manuais, sentido de responsabilidade e capacidade de aprendizagem. Valorizam-se conhecimentos básicos de mecânica e experiência prévia em oficinas, manutenção ou reparação de máquinas e equipamentos.
O candidato deverá demonstrar cuidado na utilização de ferramentas e na manipulação dos equipamentos, contribuindo para a sua preservação e bom estado de funcionamento. São igualmente valorizadas boas competências de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal, capacidade para trabalhar em equipa, compreender e cumprir orientações técnicas e transmitir de forma clara as anomalias identificadas. title: MOTORISTA DE VEÍCULOS PESADOS DE MERCADORIAS
description:
Pretende-se admitir Motorista de Pesados para assegurar o transporte, entrega e recolha de máquinas e equipamentos de aluguer nas instalações dos clientes. É obrigatória carta de condução de pesados adequada aos veículos utilizados pela empresa e experiência prévia na condução de veículos pesados. Valoriza-se experiência no transporte de máquinas e equipamentos de construção, conhecimentos de acondicionamento e segurança da carga, sentido de responsabilidade e capacidade de organização.
Procura-se um profissional com condução cuidada e preventiva, que zele pela preservação do camião e dos equipamentos transportados. Deverá possuir boas competências de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal, nomeadamente capacidade para comunicar de forma clara e cordial com clientes, transmitir informações relevantes sobre entregas, recolhas e estado dos equipamentos, e colaborar eficazmente com a equipa operacional. Valorizam-se ainda pontualidade, autonomia, capacidade de resolução de problemas e uma postura profissional orientada para a qualidade do serviço e a satisfação do cliente.

title: Italian-Speaking Technical Support Specialist (m,f) : Drone (Callcenteragent/in)
description:
Start: 03.08. or 01.09.26

We are partnering with a global technology company to recruit Italian-speaking Technical Support Specialists for a new project based in Italy.

In this role, you will provide professional technical assistance and customer support to users of cutting-edge camera drones. You will guide customers through troubleshooting, product usage, and problem resolution while ensuring an excellent overall experience. This is a great opportunity to work in a fast-paced, international environment with the latest technology.

Your Role
Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, and chat in Italian.
Troubleshoot and resolve product-related issues with camera drones.
Assist customers with setup, functionality, and maintenance guidance.
Educate users on features, firmware updates, and common usage issues.
Log and manage cases accurately in internal systems.
Collaborate with engineering and product teams to escalate complex technical problems.
Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction through timely and professional communication.

Your Qualifications
Native or fluent Italian (C1 level)
Basic knowledge of English for internal communication
Previous experience in technical support, IT, or electronics is preferred
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Excellent communication and customer service skills
Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced, international environment
Interest or experience in drones, consumer electronics, or related technology is a plus

The Offer
Full-time position with a structured onboarding and paid training
Hybrid working model (office + remote) depending on operational needs
Competitive compensation and benefits package
Career development opportunities within an international tech company
Work in a collaborative, international team and gain exposure to cutting-edge technology

title: Senior Solution Architect IT/OT Security Platforms (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
description:
Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.
As a Solution Architect for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts, while our OT Patch Management enables centralized endpoint management, patching, hardening and compliance for enterprise and production-related devices.

What we offer you
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career.  From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

You'll make an impact by

- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security Platforms (SINEC Secure Connect and ManageEngine), ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements.- You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases.- You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints.- You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps.- You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens.- You define integration concepts between connectivity services, endpoint management platforms, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems.- You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape.- You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability.- You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services

This is how you'll win us over

- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification.- Experience and Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443.- You have proven experience with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures.- You bring solid knowledge of Endpoint, Asset and Service Management Architectures, including endpoint management, asset discovery, software deployment, patch management, CMDB, and IT service management platforms.- You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps.- You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design.
- Ways of Working: - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments.- You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).
- Languages: •    Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us.
As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/arbeiten-bei-siemens/inklusion.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About Us
To solve the biggest challenges of our time, we need bright minds with the ambition to make the impossible possible. Siemens is the place where you can thrive, challenge the status quo, make an impact, and grow alongside a team of innovators who share your passion for technology. Are you in?

title: Senior Automation Expert (f/m/d) IT/OT Security Platforms (Informatiker/in)
description:
Together, we make the difference

Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.As an Automation Engineer (f/m/d) for IT/OT Security Platforms, you will play a key role in building, automating, and operating the technical foundation of these strategic services. You will work closely with service managers, solution architects, operations teams, and factories worldwide to deliver scalable, automated, and secure solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and industrial digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts.
What we offer you

- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

What part will you play?

- You design, implement, and maintain automation solutions for IT/OT Security Platforms (specifically but not exclusively SINEC Secure Connect, ensuring secure, scalable, and reliable service operations).- You develop and operate Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) solutions using modern automation frameworks and support the automated deployment of platforms and services across Siemens factory environments.- You build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, operational tooling, and automation workflows to improve service delivery, reduce manual effort, and increase operational efficiency.- You integrate platforms, tools, and services through APIs and automation frameworks to enable seamless operational processes and data flows.- You support the implementation and operation of Zero Trust connectivity solutions and contribute to the automation of policy management, provisioning, and operational workflows.- You collaborate with factories and project teams to integrate solutions into existing IT and OT environments while considering operational requirements and brownfield infrastructures.- You support troubleshooting, monitoring, and continuous service improvement activities and help ensure stable operations across global deployments.- You evaluate and leverage modern technologies such as AI-driven automation, analytics, and operational intelligence to continuously improve platform operations and deployment processes.- You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services.

What you bring to the table

- You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Automation, or a comparable qualification.- You possess strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code and Platform Automation, including Terraform, Open Tofu, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines, scripting, and automated deployment of connectivity and operations platforms (at least 3+ years of experience).- Scripting/programming skills with Python/Bash/Go.- Proven hands-on experience with Cloud (AWS) and containerized environments and microservices like Docker (at least 2+ years of experience).- You have experience with AI-driven DevOps, Operations and Automation, including the use of LLMs, GitHub Copilot, AIOps concepts, workflow automation, and analytics-driven operational improvements. - You bring hands-on experience in OpenZiti Development (optional) and API Integration (mandatory), including SDKs, REST APIs, policy automation, and custom tooling to integrate Zero Trust networking capabilities into applications and operational workflows. (1+ years of experience).- You have a solid understanding of OT Infrastructure and Industrial Protocols, including PLCs, HMIs, OPC UA, PROFINET, machine-to-machine communication, OT troubleshooting, and the secure integration of solutions into brownfield factory environments. You also understand the emerging role of AI agents in OT environments and the underlying connectivity, security, and operational requirements they introduce.- You possess knowledge of Cybersecurity, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, Active Directory, Single Sign-On (at least 1+ year of experience).- You are able to bridge IT and OT requirements and collaborate effectively with architects, factory engineers, operations teams, and business stakeholders.- You are passionate about automation, standardization, and continuous improvement, with a strong focus on reducing manual effort through scalable technical solutions.- You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).- Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About us
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

title: AJUDANTE FAMILIAR
description:
. Trabalhar diretamente com os utentes, quer individualmente, quer em grupo, tendo em vista o seu bem-estar                                                                                  . Receber os utentes e fazer a sua integração no período inicial de utilização dos equipamentos ou serviços
. Proceder ao acompanhamento diurno dos utentes, dentro e fora dos estabelecimentos e serviços, guiando-os, auxiliando-os, estimulando-os através da conversação, detetando os seus interesses e motivações e participando na ocupação dos tempos livres
. Respeitar hábitos, preferências, história de vida e dignidade do utente.
. Observar e comunicar alterações físicas ou comportamentais à Diretora Técnica
. Zelar pela segurança do utente (prevenção de quedas, autoagressão).
. Assegurar a alimentação regular dos utentes, através do transporte das mesmas
. Prestar cuidados de higiene e conforto aos utentes
. Colaborar na prestação de cuidados de saúde
. Incentivar a autonomia dos utentes
. Administrar a medicação conforme orientação do plano terapêutico
. Assegurar a higiene habitacional do utente (ex. limpeza e arrumação dos espaços, troca das roupas da cama)
. Assegurar o devido tratamento das roupas do utente
. Requisitar, receber, controlar e distribuir os artigos de higiene e conforto
. Assegurar o transporte e acompanhamento a exames e consultas quando solicitado pela Diretora Técnica
. Reportar à Diretora Técnica ocorrências relevantes no âmbito das funções exercidas
. Registar cuidados prestados e ocorrências relevantes do turno, no livro de ocorrências, ou através do canal de comunicação disponível
. Seguir as indicações e ordens dos superiores hierárquicos, nomeadamente, da Diretora Técnica
. Participar em reuniões de equipa e formações
. Cumprir normas de higiene e segurança no trabalho
. Zelar pela conservação de materiais e equipamentos
. Executar outras funções compatíveis com a função

title: Cuisinier (H/F)
description:
Au quotidien, les femmes et les hommes de l'EdA s'engagent aux côtés de nos forces armées sur le territoire national et à l'étranger.

L'EdA c'est 1 000 collaborateurs dans le monde, 20 familles de métiers, pour assurer l'approvisionnement en denrées alimentaires, la restauration collective - externalisée ou en régie - et les activités de loisirs, la gestion des camps en opérations extérieures et le soutien aux évènements.


Notre offre

Au sein de la direction International et Opérations (DIO), rattaché au second de cuisine, le cuisinier a pour mission de réaliser la production alimentaire d'un restaurant collectif et de ces prestations particulières.


Vos missions au quotidien

- Réaliser les préparations culinaires selon les fiches techniques

- Assurer les cuissons le dressage et la mise en valeur des plats

- Appliquer strictement les règles d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire (HACCP)

- Assurer le nettoyage et l'entretien du poste de travail et du matériel

- Travailler en coordination avec le reste de l'équipe du RF

- Contrôler et garantir l'entretien et la bonne utilisation des matériels mis à sa disposition

- Préparer les produits et mettre en place les matériels de cuisine

- S'assurer de la qualité des denrées fournies

- Produire, valoriser et vérifier (goût, qualité, présentation) les préparations

- Repérer et signaler les dysfonctionnements

- Veiller au bon déroulement du service dans les différents espaces de restauration

- Assurer l'accueil des convives et la gestion des enregistrements des passages viales caisses JES pour les 3 services


Votre profil
Le candidat est de nationalité française et/ou ressortissant européen.
Etablissement soumis à enquête administrative.

Votre parcours

Formation CAP/BEP restauration et/ou niveau équivalent acquis par une expérience d'au moins 2 ans dans le domaine.


Les savoir-être partagés par tous les collaborateurs de l'EdA

Esprit d'équipe, sens du service, discrétion, implication, agilité, éthique, communication, initiative


Nos propositions

Poste à pourvoir sur des enceintes militaires françaises.

Rattaché au second de cuisine.

Respect des règles de sécurité édictées par l'autorité militaire, notamment les conditions de sortie.

Logement fourni (nuitée et petit déjeuner), type appart hôtel.

Poste de contact, varié, nécessitant d'être apte à travailler en autonomie aussi bien qu'en équipe.

Contrat : CDD de droit privé, contrat français détaché, à temps plein (42h30).

Durée : 3 mois avec première mission d'un 1 mois.

Statut : Agent de maîtrise

Rémunération : 4 000 € net mensuel de package.

Pourquoi postuler

L'engagement au côté des forces armées françaises nous permet de donner du sens à nos actions et de nous accomplir au quotidien. C'est l'opportunité de mettre nos expertises et notre créativité au service de projets dimensionnants.
Pour garantir leur réussite, nous veillons à développer et conjuguer les talents de chacun.

Nous rejoindre c'est intégrer un collectif où l'humain reste au centre des attentions, qu'il soit client ou collaborateur. Nous avons la conviction que le service indéfectible que nous devons à nos prescripteurs ne peut être garanti que par la qualité de l'environnement que nous proposons à nos équipes.

A la jonction des univers militaire et civil, l'EdA est riche d'une culture de mixité.
En postulant chez nous, ne vous posez pas d'autre question que celle de savoir si vous partagez nos valeurs et ambitions.
Au-delà de votre expertise, nous recherchons les qualités qui font la force de nos équipes : éthique, implication, audace, rigueur, empathie et créativité.

Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Venez nous découvrir

title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

title: Správcovia objektov
description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím
description:
Ak Ti nie je ľahostajný život ľudí ohrozených stratou bývania a s nepriaznivým zdravotným stavom, príď do Útulku a zariadenia opatrovateľskej služby sv. Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. Ak chceš vidieť ako to vyzerá za dverami útulku, pozri si videjko: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PWIuYGiNTqE

title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

title: Account Manager Executive (German - speaking) -  Remote work in Spain - HE04 (Account-Manager/in)
description:
Experience the power of a game-changing career  

Want to be part of an innovative and growing team? We’re a global technology and services leader that powers the brands of the future. We help well-known brands — the ones you use every day — improve their businesses with technology and integrated solutions, in over 70 countries.  

If you’re looking to grow and be inspired, as an Account Manager Executive, you will be part of our team of game-changers who are powering the brands of the future in tech.  

Career growth and personal development  

This is a great opportunity to experience the power of what’s next and develop “friends for life” at the same time. We’ll give you all the training, cutting-edge technologies, and the continuing support you’ll need to succeed.  

What you will do in this role  

In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.  

As an Account Manager Executive on our team, you will:  

- Focus on developing and closing opportunities with both new and existing customers, driving acquisition, retention, and growth across mid-sized accounts.
- Own the overall account strategy and sales execution.
- Systematically qualify customer potential and address whitespace opportunities across the full product portfolio.
- Collaborate closely with the Channel team (PBM, iPBM, Proximity) to align account strategies.
- Drive PC++ Sales (including Headsets, Displays, and Care Packs) as well as Print Transactional Sales.
- Lead the solution-building process and engage pooled central inside sales specialists and presales experts when needed.
- Identify and engage new contacts within assigned accounts, elevate relationships across the full portfolio, and manage structured communications based on strategic sequencing.
- Own opportunity identification, qualification, and management. Proactively hunt within low or no SOW accounts.
- Coordinate with in-market technical consultants to provide expert support when required.
- Support or lead project management efforts, own pricing discussions, ensure compliance with global pricing guidelines, and manage negotiations and sales closure with a focus on profitability.
- Support renewals and post-sales activities in partner-led opportunities, offering guidance on cross-sell and upsell strategies based on customer needs, and ensuring an outstanding customer experience.

Your qualifications  

We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.  

Concentrix is a great match if you:  

- Are proficient or bilingual in German with advanced English level
- Have proven ability to self-prospect via cold outreach using multiple contact tools.
- Are skilled in building strong relationships with decision-makers.
- Are capable of navigating complex organizations to identify expansion opportunities.
- Are experienced in leading meetings with IT and Procurement stakeholders.
- Have strong business acumen with the ability to develop long-term growth strategies.
- Have analytical mindset to identify key business challenges and propose actionable solutions.
- have ability to manage the end-to-end sales process for transactional and, in selected cases, contractual opportunities.
- Have 1–3 years of relevant industry sales experience.
- Enjoy working in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
- Are passionate about technology, customer relationships, and business growth.

Don’t meet every requirement? No worries. We’re dedicated to creating a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace for everyone. If you feel you don’t check every box, we still encourage you to apply. We’ll do our best to match you with the right job, whether it’s this one or another role.  

What’s in it for you  

We challenge conventions to deliver outcomes unimagined by creating customer experiences that go beyond WOW. That’s why we significantly invest in our people, our infrastructure, and our capabilities to ensure long-term success for our teams, our customers, and YOU.  

In this role, we offer benefits that help support your **unique lifestyle:**  

- Full-time, permanent contract, 39 hours/week: Monday to Friday 09:00 to 18:00
- Base salary of 20,976 euros gross/year + up to 7,400 euros gross/year in bonus + private medical insurance
- Location at either our Barcelona, Malaga or Valencia office, or remote from Spain, if you are not based at one of these locations (except Canary Islands)
- Full paid training about the company and the project you will be working on
- Career development program and specialized courses

**Experience the best version of you!**  

At Concentrix, we invest in our game-changers because we know that when our people thrive, our clients and their customers thrive.  

If all this feels like the perfect next step in your career journey, we want to hear from you. Apply today and discover why over 440k+ game-changers around the globe call Concentrix their “employer of choice.”
